payload.tension: The passage states one Spirit distributes many manifestations. Now about spiritual things, brothers, I don’t want you to be ignorant. But the one and the same Spirit produces all of these, distributing to each one separately as he desires. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Paul's story.
